instruction: Resize squirrel.jpeg on the Desktop to 800x600 pixels using GIMP and overwrite the original file.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent attempted batch brightness processing: opened terminal, tried ImageMagick convert (not installed), installed it via apt, used find+convert to create _bright.jpeg copies, then opened heron_bright in GIMP with Brightness-Contrast dialog. Task was infeasible.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open terminal, run shell commands, install packages via apt, open files in GIMP via File>Open, navigate GIMP menus (Colors > Brightness-Contrast)
metadata.failure_analysis: Original task was marked infeasible (GIMP lacks built-in batch processing without scripting). Model attempted command-line workaround but evaluator returned 0 for infeasible task.
metadata.task_rationale: Decomposed batch processing into single image resize, a simple GIMP operation within model's demonstrated capability of opening images and using GIMP menus
metadata.explanation: Task requires opening squirrel.jpeg in GIMP, resizing to 800x600 via Image > Scale Image, then exporting/overwriting. Evaluator uses check_image_size to verify output dimensions.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter vm_file correctly downloads squirrel.jpeg from the expected path /home/user/Desktop/squirrel.jpeg
Metric check_image_size correctly accesses rule.get('width') and rule.get('height') directly from the rules dict, proper handling for expected.type='rule'
Expected values width=800 and height=600 exactly match the instruction requirement of 800x600 pixels
Complete coverage: the instruction's only verifiable requirement is the resized image dimensions, which the evaluator fully checks
No postconfig needed since the evaluator reads a saved file on disk, not UI state
JPEG format will not trigger the ignore_transparent path, so the standard size check applies correctly
